environment.description: Celery worker running on EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2), Python 3.9, behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules (no managed rule groups attached). Worker process runs as celery user with write access to /var/run/worker/. Redis broker accepts connections from VPC CIDR. API endpoint exposed via ALB target group on port 8080 with no request body validation. Systemd manages worker lifecycle and sends SIGTERM on stop.
